verdict_reasoning: Code implementation and local isolated verification of both worker lease recovery and automated backup pipelines are fully completed and verified across 19 unit and integration tests. Real external off-host cloud custody (e.g. production S3 bucket provisioning) remains pending infrastructure deployment.

blockers_resolved.resolution: Implemented V2 lease contract on sm_run_requests with SKIP LOCKED atomic claim, heartbeat renewal, exponential backoff stale claim recovery, and cryptographic token fencing.

Implemented SmartMoneyBackupEngine with least-privilege smart_money_backup role, LOCK_BACKUP_EXECUTION advisory lock, pg_dumpall/pg_dump archive generation, SHA-256 validation, retention management, and BackupRestoreVerifier.

remaining_blockers.description: Production S3/R2 storage bucket and credentials must be provisioned during production deployment gate.
